name: falling-sand-on-cactus
comment: WP-2.1. Cacti (81) at (0, 61, 0) and (3, 61, 0), each on sand (12) at y = 60 over stone at y = 59 (so the sand never falls). Sand set at (0, 66, 0) falls as an EntityFallingSand onto the first cactus: moveEntity calls BlockCactus.onEntityCollidedWithBlock -> Entity.attackEntityFrom (the base body: setBeenAttacked only, Entity.java:742-749), then it lands on the cactus top and places itself at y = 62. Item 0 falls from (3.5, 64, 0.5) onto the second cactus: EntityItem.attackEntityFrom takes 1 health per tick until it dies (EntityItem.java:87-95). entity_state every tick, rng_state every 10.
